name: Scene 6 - Blood Moon with Stair Elements
description: Blood moon scene with stair elements burning, center tiers dark and empty
visual_brief: Blood moon dominates the stone frame while stair elements on left and right sides of the stage have fire and burning effects. Center tiers remain dark and empty. The scene emphasizes dramatic contrast between celestial fire and architectural fire.
prompt: Blood moon dominates the stone frame while stair elements on left and right sides of the stage have fire and burning effects. Center tiers remain dark and empty. Dramatic contrast between celestial fire and architectural fire. Wide establishing shot showing blood moon within rectangular stone frame. Camera at tier 2 elevation emphasizing stair elements. Professional architectural photography with strong vertical emphasis on side stair structures. Enhanced texture details showing burning wood and stone contrast. Dramatic red-orange celestial lighting complementing architectural fire. Enhanced atmospheric depth with thick smoke and balanced composition highlighting the contrast between empty center and burning side elements.
